question.text:
For real x, which expression equals arcosh(cosh x) + arsinh(sinh x)?
(A) 2x (B) 0 (C) 2|x| (D) |x| + x (E) |x| − x

solution.text:
Hyperbolic sine is a bijection on R, so its inverse composition returns x. The principal
inverse of hyperbolic cosine has nonnegative output and returns |x|, because cosine hyper-
bolic is even and increasing on [0, ∞). Their sum is |x| + x.
